name: actual-gameplay replay + audit
command: python3 scripts/replay.py drawLine|pinPull|runner ; python3 scripts/audit.py drawLine|pinPull|runner
notes: Drives the Actual Gameplay iPhone app on the simulator. replay.py plays every level's stored solution (regression suite, must be 12/12); audit.py stress-tests levels (pin singles/pairs/all, jittered strokes + dumb strokes, runner steering policies) and prints TRIVIAL/FRAGILE/BROKEN verdicts. Both wait for simulator boot and warm up first (cold boot starves the first scene's run loop). Snapshots under build/replay and build/audit.

name: add-reminder
notes: Create Apple Reminders, including repeating ones (EventKit via mkreminder.swift). AppleScript cannot set recurrence.

name: aggregator.py (job-search ATS dataset lane)
notes: Streams 59 gzip chunks (~77 MB) one at a time, peak ~420 MB RSS. Dataset salary is an estimate, never gate 3. Seen-file in job-search/state/aggregator-seen.json.

name: ai-bill-scan
notes: Scans govinfo BILLSTATUS bulk zips for a whole Congress and returns every AI-related bill plus a per-member index (sponsor/cosponsor, party, date, bucket). Primary-source whip lists without an API key or rate limit. Zips: https://www.govinfo.gov/bulkdata/BILLSTATUS/119/{s,hr}/BILLSTATUS-119-{s,hr}.zip

name: alltrails
notes: AllTrails data is crowd-sourced: confirm lengths, elevation, difficulty and conditions with the land manager (USFS/NPS/state) before a plan depends on them; output labels stats 'AllTrails (crowd-sourced)'. search/trail/weather: official MCP endpoint https://www.alltrails.com/mcp (no auth; also registered user-scope as MCP server 'alltrails'). reviews/gpx: system Chrome NON-headless off screen (--window-position=-2400,-2400) because DataDome 403s plain HTTP; data from the Next.js flight payload. Only ~5 reviews (first embedded page). GPX has no elevation. Account lane: 'auth --from-chrome' decrypts Chrome v10 cookies (needs access_token + refresh_token) into alltrails/secrets/cookies.json (gitignored, 0600); 'upload' drives /explore/custom-routes/new (Upload a route, Upload, Save), maps default PUBLIC (private maps cannot be shared; --private), share URL = /explore/custom-routes/<slug>; each <trk> = one segment, <wpt> = markers. API writes must be fetch() INSIDE the page with the captured x-at-key/x-csrf-token headers; Playwright page.request gets a DataDome 403. Escape closes the free-trial upsell; never click it. Do not wrap upload in mist-progress: its pty swallowed the output and one of three uploads did not land. Cache in alltrails/cache: MCP 6 h, pages 12 h; --fresh skips it.

name: analyze-leaf
notes: Offline NFC key analysis: confirms or refutes a candidate master key against a DESFire card's free-read signature (AN10957 4.5.1 + Appendix B). --selftest validates against NXP vectors. Cannot recover unknown keys.

name: app-shell build-app
command: app-shell/build-app.sh "Name" slug http://127.0.0.1:PORT/ launchd.label [--plist P] [--log P] [--icon P.icns] [--bundle-id ID] [--health URL]
notes: Builds /Applications/<Name>.app native WKWebView wrapper for a local web app (pywebview, shared venv, launchd kickstart, TCC-safe). Used by The Priory.app and Trawl.app.

name: arctic-shift-scan
notes: Full-subreddit post scan via Arctic Shift archive API (no Reddit creds). Writes reddit/data/kc-events-scan.json: all posts + megathread comment trees. Feeds /local-events. Staleness asserted on newest-post age, never HTTP 200. Recon: vault recon/2026-08-23-reddit-access-paths.md

name: audiotee
notes: Build: swift build -c release. Raw PCM to stdout, JSON logs to stderr. Any explicit --sample-rate converts to 16-bit signed int (mono by default); no rate keeps the device rate as 32-bit float. --mute silences the tapped process at the speakers. Needs System Audio Recording permission for the RESPONSIBLE app (the Console when MIST runs it from a chat, Terminal when Alex runs it); without it the tap runs and records silence, no error. PID translate fails inside the Claude Code sandbox: run with the sandbox off. The harness govee-music daemon wraps it.

name: auto-update.sh
notes: Gated: once per 20h, AC power, 1-6 AM or 20 min idle; --force skips. brew pin <name> holds a formula. Notifies (banner + Discord) only on a failed step or a major-version bump. Log: ~/Library/Logs/exobrain/auto-update.log.

name: bg3save
notes: Wrapper over hylqs97/bg3-save-skill (local branch macos). LSLib DLLs are x86-64: bin/dotnet shim runs an x64 .NET 8 runtime (bg3-tools/dotnet-x64) under Rosetta. On macOS the bridge's package-extract replaces Divine (Divine's Uri check rejects Unix paths). Rebuild the bridge with Homebrew dotnet@8 SDK: dotnet build tools/lslib-bridge -p:LSLibDir=~/.cache/bg3-save-skill/lslib-1.20.4/Packed/Tools. Positive control: test/synthetic.lsv. Read-only use; tool supports experimental flag edits, never run them on a live save without a backup.

name: bg3wiki-mcp
command: claude mcp get bg3wiki   (user-scope MCP: npx -y @professional-wiki/mediawiki-mcp-server, CONFIG=playstation/bg3/bg3wiki.mcp.json)
notes: Read-only; config sets bg3.wiki as the default wiki. Loads in new sessions only. bg3.wiki has Cargo (structured tables), CirrusSearch and TextExtracts; the Controls page redirects to Options, whose tables need HTML parsing (TextExtracts drops tables). Polite UA set via MCP_USER_AGENT.

name: birth-chart-auto
command: python chart.py NAME YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM "City, State" ; python pipeline/prose.py brief|check work/<slug> <slug>
notes: Needs .venv from requirements.txt. Ephemeris files fetch on first run (git fallback; EPHE_VIA_GIT=1 forces it). render.py falls back to HTML if Chromium cannot start. Time 'unknown' draws noon. Builds refuse prose_<slug>.json that fails prose.py check.

name: Bookmarklets page
notes: Static file:// page of draggable javascript: bookmarklets (Wayback snapshot, Wayback Save Page Now). Add new ones to the BM object in index.html.

name: census.py
notes: Stdlib only. Reads Plaud JSON transcripts, iMessage cache (uses imessage-reader.py decoder), Gmail Maildir ~/Mail/gmail (address from CENSUS_EMAIL or git config), ~/.claude/projects session logs (filters routine prompts, sidechains, skill bodies; >800-word messages = unknown tier), vault Alex's Notes + [!alex] callouts, Discord digest + claude-bot chatter, site posts.json. Full run ~3 min. Writes data/census.json (gitignored), never writes text. Do not wrap in mist-progress: the pty swallows the table.

name: check_boundaries.py
notes: Module-boundary checker for the harness (top-level dirs are islands). Runs automatically in the post-edit quality-gate hook.

name: Claude Animation (song-sync)
notes: p5.brush watercolour animation kit (fork of JohnHeibel/ClaudeAnimationBase). song-sync writes bpm/offset/lyric cues. Use via /animate.

name: claude-stable-path
notes: Pins the auto-updating claude CLI to one unchanging path (~/.local/share/claude/stable/claude) so its TCC grants, above all Full Disk Access, stop dying every release. Runs on WatchPaths via com.exobrain.claude-stable-path.

name: comp-infer
notes: Exit 0 CONFIDENT, 1 NOT CONFIDENT, 2 NO DATA. Floors from .env via comp_floors. Agent fallback runs claude -p on Sonnet with WebSearch/WebFetch (about 1 to 3 min); its figures count only when found on the cited page. Pages behind JS or bot walls cannot confirm, so they read as NOT CONFIDENT. --write only on CONFIDENT. Inside mist-progress the pty can swallow the output; run it directly.

name: contact-check
notes: Reads only Markdown tables with Name and Title columns; free-form contact bullets are not checked. --note exits 1 on a hit; the no-arg audit skips closed/withdrawn/rejected/skipped notes.

name: crm-overdue-scan
notes: Scans People/ notes for CRM overdue status (category/frequency/last_contact). Read-only. --all shows non-overdue too; --today YYYY-MM-DD to backdate. Reports incomplete frontmatter separately instead of dropping it. Built for the daily briefing's CRM step.

name: dedup-lookup
notes: Status-aware job-listing dedup across Job Listings/ and Archive/. Indexes ~331 notes by frontmatter type: job-listing, reports status/reapply/date_added so the Re-Apply on Repost table can be applied instead of blanket-skipping. --stats shows status counts and every reapply:true watchlist employer.

name: defuddle
notes: Web page -> clean markdown. Use instead of WebFetch for ordinary pages; see the /defuddle skill.

name: dice.py (job-search Dice lane)
notes: Dice job board discovery lane for /job-search: parses server-rendered job cards via curl_cffi Chrome impersonation, gates remote/full-time/contract/comp (band rule), KC-metro onsite seats at the onsite floor. Dice ignores its own remote filter.

name: discord-digest-fetch.py
notes: Pull the friend-group Discord digest. Backs the /discord-digest skill and the com.exobrain.discord-digest job.

name: dolphin-happy-mode
notes: Decodes and patches the Flipper Zero dolphin state file (/int/.dolphin.state). Sets DolphinFlagHappyMode so butthurt is always reported as 0 (mood system off) and rewrites the saved_struct checksum. Pull the file with flipper-ble read, patch, write back, reboot os.

name: dribbble_refs.py
notes: Dribbble refuses bare curl; this uses headless Chromium with a normal user agent and fetches the images through the browser context. Saves only images 600 px wide or more plus og:image.

name: exposure_audit.py
notes: Scan tracked files for leaked personal data (IP/MAC shapes, names, credentials) before anything ships. Used by /exobrain-audit and /cybersecurity-bodyguard.

name: fanedit-cc-align
notes: Needs work/part<N>.srt from whisper.cpp with -ml 1 -sow (word-level). fill_gaps.sh re-runs no-VAD whisper on >30 s silent windows (action scenes) into part<N>.extra.srt; loop hallucinations are filtered on load. Sources in subs-src/ come from the legacy rest.opensubtitles.org search (X-User-Agent: TemporaryUserAgent; IMDb ids need 7 digits). Drop non-SDH and ad cues. qa.py --shift 3 is the positive control.

name: fantasy consensus judge
notes: The self-grading-loop fix: builds draftbot/consensus.json from CBS + FFToday full-PPR season projections (sources the bot never drafts on; FFToday LeagueID=190 = full PPR, verified) and grades the open draft room under both boards. The number to read is the rank gap: ~0 = robust build, large positive = our board flatters us. FIREWALL: vor.py must never read consensus.json.

name: fantasy correlation table
command: cd fantasy && python3 -m ffmodel.corr && python3 -m ffmodel.corr validate
notes: Writes ffmodel/corr_table.json (tracked); espncli.value.load_corr reads it. validate fits on 2022-2024 and scores synthetic 2025 matchups: 90% coverage on stacked lineups 83.3% independent vs 87.4% correlated.

name: fantasy disagreement ledger
notes: Registers board-vs-consensus disagreements as predictions (A outscores B) and settles them with actual ESPN season points (kona actuals: seasonId+source 0+split 0; positive control = season 2025 returns Gibbs 366.9). Settle weekly in season. Only settled results may flow back into the board; also the designated judge for the parked elite-bias correction in vor.py (VOR_BIAS_STRENGTH, default 0 after a negative experiment).

name: fantasy divergence signoff
notes: Pre-draft gate: no counter-consensus pick without a signature. Compares board vs FantasyPros ECR POSITIONAL ranks (so 1-QB structural timing never flags), lists material gaps; each gets 'keep --thesis' (auto-registers a ledger bet) or 'correct' (vor.py re-slots to ECR rank at next build). vor.py warns on unsigned divergences at build; 'status' exits nonzero if any remain = draft-morning gate. Overrides in gitignored fantasy/board-overrides.json.

name: fantasy draft examiner
notes: Outside audit of the autopilot's picks against FantasyPros ECR (100+ experts), the one yardstick the bot and its sim do not share. --live audits the draft actually open in driver.py (reads Pick History, rebuilds the board at each of our picks); without it, replays a simulated draft for --seat. Most flags in a 1-QB league are 'consensus would take a QB2' and are dismissible; a flag naming a skill player is the real signal. --refresh re-pulls ECR on draft morning.

name: fantasy draft scoreboard
notes: Grades every team in the open ESPN draft room on projected optimal starters, same ESPN projections the VOR board uses. Reads Pick History (full names, deduped on pick number). --rosters N prints the top N rosters so a rank turns into a lesson. Known bias: it measures what the bot optimizes, so pair it with examiner.py --live. Run BEFORE navigating away; practice leagues 404 on the ESPN API.

name: fantasy draft simulator
notes: Offline 13-seat draft sim vs calibrated opponents (ESPN AUTO rank-list bots or crowd-ADP humans). Grades optimal starting lineups on ESPN projections, same scale as draftbot/grade.py. Policy knobs via --policy JSON. Mirrors autopilot.js scoring; keep in sync.

name: fantasy draft supervisor
notes: Single owner of the driver cmd channel while a draft runs: polls the armed autopilot, logs each new pick to supervise.log, and drives a MIST Console progress bar off roster count. Start it right after 'arm.py arm' and read supervise.log instead of polling arm.py, so nothing races on result.json. Exits at 16/16.

name: fantasy fpranks judge
notes: snapshot <week> saves MIST ranks and the live half-PPR consensus (fantasypros.com weekly pages, ecrData) to fantasy/forecasts/fp/; score scores every saved week; week <n> --tsv prints ranks. The slot-value curve is not published by FantasyPros; it is the mean k-th best half-PPR score over full-slate weeks of the three prior seasons.

name: fantasy injury table
notes: Writes ffmodel/injury_table.json (tracked). current_cached(season, week) reads this week's practice line from nflverse by ESPN id, cached one hour. espn check attaches p_play, practice and injury_ratio to unlocked rows.

name: fantasy market projection
notes: Lines come from ESPN's core API propBets (ESPN BET to 2025 week 13 with prices, DraftKings from 2026 with lines only); python3 -m ffmodel.props <season> --weeks a-b crawls finished games into fantasy/.cache/props/. fit --seasons 2024,2025 writes ffmodel/market_model.json; evaluate scores leave-one-season-out. Projections are conditional on the player playing (props are void otherwise).

name: fantasy nflraw
notes: Caches parquet per season in fantasy/.cache/nflraw/ (finished seasons permanent, current season 12h). Matches ESPN on 854/854 offense+K and 66/72 D/ST player-weeks (2026 wk1-5). ESPN yards allowed = opponent net yards; points allowed exclude the opponent's defensive and return TDs.

name: fantasy opportunity overlay
notes: 2025 volume metrics (tgt/g, touch/g, target share, wopr, snap pct) + TD-regression flags via nflreadpy: BUY = heavy volume TD-shorted (Lamb 9 tgt/g 3 TD), SELL = TD-inflated on modest volume (Henderson 10 TD 46% snaps). Writes draftbot/opportunity.json; tier_sheet.py renders the flags on draft-sheet.html. Advisory only: a BUY is a thesis candidate for signoff.py keep, the bot never reads it. Rebuild before the draft after any late-preseason data update.

name: fantasy role model
notes: No PyMC: closed-form updates in numpy. live(season, week) works without participation data; the routes variant (2016-2025 participation) adds 0.004 MAE at most. Evidence: fantasy/research/role_eval.py and the vault note Fantasy Football Role Model 2026-10-15.

name: fantasy season_sim
notes: Rosters valued on espncli.value.ros_rate. sigma is measured from the played weeks once there are 4 (29.3 on weeks 1-5 of 2026), else 22; printed on stderr. Without --live the week in progress is ignored until ESPN moves to the next scoring period. --force keeps both simulated scores and only picks which side gets the higher one; repeatable. Forced or live runs do not write draftbot/season_sim_latest.json or .cache/leverage.json. --leverage runs about 30 batches on common random numbers; use --sims 40000 for stable per-week numbers (about 10 s).

name: fantasy trade_scan
command: python3 fantasy/trade_scan.py [--our-view espn|board --min-gain N --their-floor N --top N]
notes: Enumerates every 1-for-1 and 2-for-1 with each rival; scores both lineups on ESPN projections (their screen) or our VOR board (our view); paired season-sim for title/playoff/bye deltas. Pre-week-1 result: no win-win trades exist on shared projections; edges are belief trades (BUY flags) or absent managers.

name: fantasy vor board
notes: Builds draftbot/vor.json: value-over-replacement fantasy board from ESPN 2026 projections (league-scored full PPR) crossed with The Ringer's positional ranks. Replacement = QB13/RB30/WR34/TE14 for the 13-team league. Rebuild the MORNING OF the draft; output is gitignored derived data.

name: fantasy-cloud-deploy
notes: Run again after ff refresh: the cloud copy of the ESPN cookies is a Worker secret. Uses CF_SHARE_API_TOKEN (CF_API_TOKEN lacks KV). Writes gitignored hub.json.

name: fantasy-cloud-run
notes: Runs inside a cloud Claude session. start exits 3 on MAC_UP or SKIP. Pass --token: the auto-mode classifier denies a hand-written credential fetch.

name: fb
notes: General read-only Facebook toolkit. Cookie-auth headed browser (Playwright) + GraphQL capture; works on any group/page/profile via named targets. Subcommands: status, find-group <q>, crawl <target> [--url] [--minutes] [--headless], parse <target>, report <target> [--top N] [--per-year N]. crawl->parse->report; outputs top-N + by-year with images. All cookies/data/reports gitignored. Scroll reaches ~8-10mo of group history per session; deep history needs looped sessions or GraphQL cursor-replay (not built).

name: fb refresh-cookies
notes: Refresh facebook/secrets/cookies.txt from the live Chrome/Brave session on macOS. Direct AES-128-CBC decrypt of the on-disk cookie store; key = PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1(Keychain 'Chrome Safe Storage', 'saltysalt', 1003, 16). SHA1 not SHA256. Copied-profile browser launch does NOT work (key bound to original profile). --browser chrome|brave, --dry-run.

name: fit-gate
notes: Reads the '## Fit scorecard' table on job listing notes. Threshold 0.80 and MIN_ROWS 5 are constants in the file. --enforce never touches applied/interviewing/offer notes and never declines an unscored note.

name: freehire-lane
notes: q orders but does not narrow; cities facet does not filter; Python default UA gets 403. Seen-file in state/.

name: geo
notes: Geolocation bench behind the /geoguesser skill. Subcommands: sun (latitude from a shadow, no clock needed), sunpos (forward check), pano (keyless Street View coverage + capture date), score (GeoGuessr scoring curve both ways), where/geocode (Nominatim), overpass, enhance (crop+upscale a sign until it is readable).

name: Ghidra
notes: Standalone zip in ~/tools (cask needs sudo, blocked in non-interactive shells; the release zip does not). analyzeHeadless for batch/scripted runs, ghidraRun for the GUI. Set JAVA_HOME to the openjdk@21 path or it errors 'Unable to locate a Java Runtime'. Downloaded from github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra releases 2026-09-20.

name: great-wheel-charting
command: tools/columns.py BOOK.pdf OUT.txt; tools/chart_check.py CHART.json; tools/chart_merge.py CHART.json
notes: Run columns.py on an OCR'd PDF (ocrmypdf first if there is no text layer); it reads each page's own size. chart_merge keeps the private overlay. Format: docs/CHARTING.md.

name: great-wheel-map-mask
command: tools/maps/mask.py MAP OUT.png --sea R,G,B [--land R,G,B] [--lava R,G,B] [--unknown R,G,B] [--dark N] [--erase X0,Y0,X1,Y1] [--line-rows] [--open N] [--min-area N] [--size 2048]
notes: Needs numpy, scipy and Pillow. Output is red for land, green for lava, equirectangular 2:1. Use --tol around 20 for flat-color outline maps (anti-aliased grey near white reads as sea at higher values); hex maps with grid lines and borders need --open 5 and --min-area 40. The site reads the PNG as look.proc.mask on a terran-style world.

name: gridpoint-build-install
notes: Signed build + wireless install of the Gridpoint weather app to the iPhone. Verifies embedded profile expiry before install.

name: gridpoint-monitor
notes: Logs NWS + Open-Meteo forecasts and KMKC obs to SQLite every 30 min (launchd com.exobrain.weather-monitor). score.py = per-source accuracy report.

name: guard-identity
notes: Registered in ~/.claude/settings.json (user level, every project). Reads identifiers from the gitignored .env MYKCMO_CONTACT_* and MYKCMO_HOME_ADDRESS. ask when attended, deny when MIST_UNATTENDED=1. MIST_IDENTITY_GUARD=off disables. Positive control: the canary string in the docstring. Log ~/Library/Logs/exobrain/guard-identity.log. Tests tests/test_guard_identity.py.

name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
notes: Native SurrealEngine clone of HP1 for Apple silicon. Compiled launcher, so scan_apps() cannot infer its repo.

name: hiker-mealplan
notes: Reads the vegan Hiker Food Chart xlsx in the vault (Attachments/Hiker Food Chart). Edit solve() keyword args for targets. Uses min(label kcal, macro kcal); drops rows that disagree by >20%. scipy milp.

name: hp1-actor-dumps
notes: Reads the engine's 'dumpactors CLASS' log lines; run the level first with --exec-at=T:dumpactors baseChar at some level times. --moving keeps rows with non-zero acceleration. Prefix match is case-insensitive.

name: hp1-camera-log
notes: Reads the 'Gamepad test' lines that --fake-gamepad runs log once a second, and dumpprops lines for player Location/Rotation, player.cam Location and player.myHUD DebugString. Rows with CutState are cutscene cameras.

name: hp1-check-staged
notes: Paths are relative to native/SurrealEngine. Needs a configured build (build/CMakeFiles/SurrealCommon.dir/flags.make). Pair with patchutils: git diff -- FILE | grepdiff -E PATTERN --output-matching=hunk | git apply --cached. Checks compile only (no link).

name: hp1-fn
notes: Reads native/re/decomp/<dll>.c written by ExportDecomp.java. Patterns match an entry address exactly or a substring of the qualified name; --max caps output.

name: hp1-ghidra-export
notes: Needs JAVA_HOME=openjdk@21 and Homebrew ghidra 12.1.4 (libexec/support/analyzeHeadless). GHIDRA_HEADLESS_MAXMEM=3G suits the 8 GB Mac. Engine.dll (2 MB) takes ~14 min including analysis. Output: <dll>.c (every function, '// ==== <addr> <name>' headers) and <dll>.functions.tsv. MSVC ILT exports are 5-byte JMP stubs; the decompiler follows them, so exported names print with their real bodies.

name: hp1-layout
notes: Parses native/hp1-script-source/pubsrc/Engine/Inc/EngineClasses.h. MSVC 32-bit packing: BITFIELD runs pack into DWORDs, BYTE aligns to 1, others to 4; UObject base is 0x28. Validated: Mesh 0x164, AnimLast 0x22c, class size 0x25c match the retail code.

name: hp1-run-test
notes: Boots the native engine muted with --url, --quit-after and --shot; a perl alarm watchdog kills hangs at 3x the run time + 60 s. Frames come from the renderer (ReadPixels after present), so no screen-recording permission is needed; PPMs are converted to PNG with /usr/bin/python3 PIL. Log lands in OUT/run.log.

name: hp1-upkg
notes: Generic UE1 package reader (version 64+ name tables). Shows the script state frame of RF_HasStack exports and the property tags; class-specific data after the tags is only counted. Object references resolve through the import table.

name: hp1-utex
notes: Palette (P8) textures only. A texture that does not decode that way is skipped with a message on stderr. Needs Pillow (the system python3 has it). It imports upkg from its own folder, so do not run it with python3 -I. Repeated export names get _2, _3 in --out.

name: imessage-reader.py
notes: Read iMessages from the local chat.db: recent, search, unread, and chat by phone number or contact name (names resolve through the AddressBook databases, fixed 2026-09-22).

name: imessage-send.py
notes: Send an iMessage. Always sign outbound messages "-MIST (Alex's assistant)".

name: inbox-iphone-build-install
notes: Builds the native Inbox iPhone app (SwiftUI Gmail client) and pushes it to the paired iPhone over the devicectl tunnel. Free-team signing expires every 7 days; re-run this when the app stops launching. Phone must be unlocked and on USB or same network.

name: indeed.py (job-search Indeed lane)
notes: Real Chrome headless via patchright under uv. Logged-out Indeed shows page 1 only (page 2+ is a sign-in wall); limit=50 triggers Cloudflare. Run 3+ angles for breadth.

name: ios-sideload-refresh
notes: Rebuilds and wirelessly reinstalls iOS sideloads before their provisioning profiles expire. --status/--discover/--force/--quiet. Manual only: the twice-daily launchd agent was retired 2026-09-15 when the paid developer plan moved profiles from 7 days to a year.

name: itch-free-download
notes: Needs patchright (system python3). Works for free and name-your-own-price pages hosted on itch.io; an external-link upload (an author's mailing-list page) is not downloadable this way.

name: jd-snapshot.py
notes: Re-execs under uv with patchright. Exit 0 = saved + comp seen/unlisted, 1 = saved but band not on page, 2 = nothing saved (load failed or page closed/not found; note not moved). Prefers original_listing, then listing_url, then apply_url.

name: job-pipeline
notes: Public repo BaesTheorem/job-pipeline. Personal values in gitignored profile.yaml; JOB_PIPELINE_PROFILE overrides the path. Harness job-search/ keeps copies of jobprofile.py, freehire.py, liveness.py, runlog.py; keep them the same.

name: jobspy_lane.py (job-search Glassdoor/ZipRecruiter lane)
notes: Re-execs under uv with python-jobspy. ZipRecruiter returned 0 rows (blocked) on 2026-10-13; Glassdoor works. Seen-file in job-search/state/jobspy-seen.json.

name: kc-crash-geocoder
notes: Needs layers/centerlines.geojson + layers/osm_highways.geojson (fetch_layers.py, fetch_osm_highways.py) and crashes_kcmo.csv. Ramp ids (RP nnnn) cannot be placed. Median error 11 m vs MoDOT coords. Lives in the vault since 2026-10-06.

name: kcmo-jobs
notes: Re-runs itself under ~/.local/bin/uv with patchright; needs Google Chrome. Opens an off-screen Chrome window for ~1 min. First run is a baseline (state/kcmo-snapshot.json). Floors from comp_floors (.env JOB_ONSITE_FLOOR).

name: kcurbex
notes: KC Urbex forum: index site reports to Obsidian (Areas/Adventure & Creativity/Urbex), sync board meetups to Google Calendar. Account is Tier 1, so only f=30 and f=109 are visible; the archive is gated and Tier 2 is granted socially at meetups. Watcher: com.exobrain.kcurbex-watch, every 12h.

name: lane-runlog
command: python3 job-search/runlog.py wrap dice -- python3 job-search/dice.py "IT analyst" --days 3
notes: Appends to state/runs.jsonl; lanes that count themselves hand counts to the wrapper (RUNLOG-COUNTS line). yield --days N for the report.

name: listings.py
notes: tidy --dry-run first; --min-age N skips notes touched in the last N minutes. Ledger at job-search/state/near-miss-ledger.jsonl is JSONL with raw U+2028 inside strings, so read it with split('\n'), never splitlines(). A near-miss folder holding any artifact other than posting PNGs is kept.

name: loopkit
notes: Each piece is a uv script that imports loopkit. Layers render in parallel processes, and each stem is cached in tmp/loopkit-cache/<slug>/ (83 MB per 216 s stem), so a mix-only change takes about 1 minute; a full 216 s render takes about 10 minutes and peaks near 1.4 GB. Use --dump for the score checks, --check to render and measure, --measure to re-measure the last render. Name chords from the first cycle when the tuning drifts by a comma. Embed the MP3 with #loop=2,<2+period> for a gapless loop in the Console (needs a Cmd-R after a front-end update).

name: lowes-stores
notes: Recent All the Places runs often have near-zero lowes_us features (Lowe's blocks the scraper); pick a run whose stats/_results.json shows 1,000+ features. 2026-07-11-13-32-25 had 1,763. Refuses to write under 1,000 stores.

name: mcp-call
notes: Uses npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector --cli. OAuth servers do not work (use their own CLI). stdio servers launch through a temp script in $TMPDIR because the Inspector eats dash arguments (npx -y). Output: text content of the tool result, else structuredContent JSON.

name: memory_eval.py
command: python3 scripts/memory_eval.py build; ~/Documents/the-priory/.venv/bin/python scripts/memory_eval.py run --tag NAME
notes: run needs numpy + sentence-transformers (embedder venv). Data in gitignored data/memory-eval/.

name: mesh-map
notes: Site list is gitignored mesh/sites.json; outputs go to its out_dir (never the repo). Reads the GeoTIFF tiepoint because the USGS ImageServer grows the requested bbox to keep pixels square. PNG render uses the installed Playwright headless shell with swiftshader.

name: mid2mp3 / mp32mid
notes: MIDI <-> audio conversion. mp32mid needs Basic Pitch with ONNX.

name: MIST crystal animations
notes: MIST's bipyramid crystal: 11 animations x 7 looks, transparent WebP (256) + WebM (512) + GIF. Private repo BaesTheorem/mist-anims.

name: MIST Studio
notes: Port 5032, launchd com.exobrain.mist-studio (plist source in studio/, copy in ~/Library/LaunchAgents). Backends in Settings: HF Space ACE-Step/Ace-Step-v1.5 (every GPU call reserves ~180s of the daily free ZeroGPU pool), self-hosted acestep-api on a rented GPU (no quota), mock. Stems = local demucs (segment 7). Lyrics = claude -p with settings off. Art = mist-image. Tests: pytest tests/test_mist_studio.py.

name: mist-chatterbox-voice
notes: Separate venv .venv-chatterbox (requirements-chatterbox.txt). Loads model + speaker conditioning once; one synthesis at a time. First start downloads ~1.5 GB of weights. Console voice.py starts it on demand.

name: mist-launch
notes: install.sh builds and signs with the Console's team identity into ~/.local/bin/mist-launch; grant it Full Disk Access once. sweep.py refuses to apply without the grant; --installed <label> for plists no repo tracks; backups in ~/.local/share/mist-launch/backups. Re-run install.sh after a certificate renewal.

name: mist-progress
notes: Live progress bar in the MIST Console. Wrap ANY download/upload/install/clone that takes more than a few seconds. Also start/set/done for progress you compute yourself.

name: monthly-climate-history
notes: Charts a month's long-run climate history for any US county/point. tavg from NOAA nClimGrid county series (1895+); dewpoint and humidity from ERA5 via Open-Meteo (1940+, since nClimGrid has no moisture variables). PEP 723 script, runs via uv, no venv. Writes light + dark PNGs plus source CSV to weather/out/. Trend line carries a 95% band and the headline says 'no detectable trend' when the interval straddles zero. Renamed from monthly-temp-history 2026-09-05.

name: moreboards.py (job-search multi-board lane)
notes: Re-execs under the harness .venv for curl_cffi. Seen-file in job-search/state/moreboards-seen.json limits output to new postings; --no-save for test runs. SimplyHired remote flag comes from the search facet, verify in the JD.

name: mp (missing-person toolkit)
notes: Public missing-person search assist: NCIC/state-feed + NamUs case status, unidentified-person candidate ranking, newsroom watch, Overpass terrain for ground search. Public repo BaesTheorem/missing-person, NO personal data; case files live in the vault at ~/Exobrain/Areas/Community/Missing Persons/cases/. See /missing-person skill.

name: musictheory-2008
notes: Local mirror of musictheory.net circa 2008-12-02, rebuilt from the Internet Archive. Flash trainers run via vendored Ruffle (WASM). Serves on :8008; must be served, not opened via file:// (WASM is blocked on file origins). Private repo BaesTheorem/musictheory-2008.

name: narrate.py
notes: Narrate a note or piped text in Alex's cloned MIST voice. Slower than real time, so pre-render only. Needs serve.py running.

name: ocr_book.py (Turn To)
command: ~/Documents/turn-to/.venv/bin/python tools/ocr_book.py BOOK.pdf OUT_DIR [--first N --last N] [--unit line|token]
notes: Renders each page with pdftoppm at 360 dpi and reads it with Apple LiveText through ocrmac; skips pages already done, so a run resumes. LiveText beats the Vision framework on book scans but misses isolated single digits and reads Palatino .' as ! or a bare quote. Run three workers on disjoint page ranges (about 1 page/s total on the Air).

name: Open in Google Calendar (.ics handler)
notes: Builds ~/Applications/Open in Google Calendar.app and registers it as the default .ics handler, so calendar invites open in Google Calendar instead of Apple Calendar. Self-contained: the installer inlines a full RFC 5545 parser (line unfolding, TZID to UTC, all-day, DURATION without DTEND, RRULE, VALARM skipping). 1-5 events open pre-filled create pages, 6+ opens the import page. Private repo BaesTheorem/ic-to-gcal.

name: opfp-sync
notes: Skips if checked <7 days ago (stamp .opfp_last_check) unless --force. Stashes the local rename.py patch across a ff-only pull. Deletes upstream-deleted NFOs only when no video uses the name. Called from dubpace-update.sh before rename.py; notifies only on failure or a core-file change.

name: orrery-models
command: blender -b --factory-startup --python tools/assets/build_models.py -- [rocks skull spindle windlauer garden bral] [--preview DIR]
notes: Run tools/assets/fetch_models.py first (sources go to the gitignored sources/models/). Output: site/assets/models/*.glb (Draco for the big ones). Blender 4.2+; preview renders use EEVEE. The skull source is CC BY-SA 4.0, so skull.glb is too.

name: penny-lane
notes: Server on :5033 under com.exobrain.penny-lane (launchd), scan job 4x daily, sweep nightly. config.json holds zip + store ids (gitignored). HD GraphQL: 206 = retry, pageSize>24 = 403, products(itemIds) max 12. Lowe's blocks ~70 req/15 min for 72+ min. Walmart PX-walls after ~25 req. DG: pennyOrZeroPriceItem flag is the penny truth. Phone: Settings -> Phone access QR; discovery doc on the mist-share Worker KV.

name: pianokit
notes: Each piece is a uv script that imports pianokit. Needs fluidsynth, ffmpeg, and the 1.27 GB Salamander SF2 in ~/Library/Audio/Sounds/Banks (download in the README). Accompaniment below velocity 37 is almost silent in that bank. --balance shows whether the melody sits 3-5 LU above the accompaniment. --tuning just writes MIDI Tuning Standard messages per chord (files get a -just suffix). Output goes to tmp/audio/.

name: plaud-fetch.py
notes: Spawns node on the local @plaud-ai/mcp dist/index.js (PLAUD_MCP_JS overrides) and calls list_files + get_transcript over stdio JSON-RPC, so it shares the MCP's login; if 'Not authenticated', run the MCP login tool first (callback listener on :8199 lives only 2 min). API returns 429 after ~100 transcripts: 1.5 s delay + backoff built in. ~8 recordings have no cloud transcript (no JSON reply). Output data/plaud/<file_id>.json, gitignored.

name: posting-liveness
notes: Closed only on 404/410, Ashby id absent, Workday canApply false or 403 S22, or a visible banner (scripts stripped). Never changes applied notes.

name: priory
notes: The Priory news aggregator CLI (deterministic Ground News + Base Rate Times clone). Web UI on 127.0.0.1:5025. Postgres 17 db 'priory'. See FORK.md for divergence from upstream MuckScraper.

name: ps5-autopilot
command: nohup playstation/.venv/bin/python playstation/ps5-autopilot.py > tmp/ps5-live/autopilot.out 2>&1 &!   (mode: echo '{"mode": "hunt|hold|pause"}' > tmp/ps5-live/autopilot.json)
notes: Needs ps5-session running. HUD coordinates are for Battlefront Classic Collection at 1280x720, player 1 in the top half. R2 fires, R1 swaps weapon, X jumps (and selects in menus). Pause it before menus: on a results screen it taps X after 3 s without a radar. Stuck detection fires falsely on featureless snow. Log: tmp/ps5-live/autopilot.log, counters: autopilot.state.json.

name: ps5-pair
notes: Run with the playstation venv interpreter. Credentials land in ~/.pyremoteplay/.profile.json (secret). The redirect URL's code is single use; a failed exchange means sign in again. register needs the PS5 Link Device PIN screen open. Console address: --host, then PS5_HOST, then UDP 9302 discovery.

name: ps5-session
notes: One session per PSN account; starting it drops a local controller on the same account (the couch player picks Guest). Needs a registered profile (ps5-pair). Writes tmp/ps5-live/latest.jpg every 0.5 s, logs to tmp/ps5-live/session.log, pid in session.pid. Exit 2 when the console ends the session. Stop with 'ps5ctl quit'.

name: ps5-smoke
notes: Needs a registered profile first (ps5-pair). Saves PNGs to tmp/ps5-smoke/. Default taps RIGHT at 3s and LEFT at 5s on the home screen; pass empty strings for a frames-only run. Exit 0 = frames decoded and taps sent.

name: ps5ctl
command: playstation/ps5ctl <command> [args]   (tap BTN, press/release BTN, move X Y MS, look X Y MS, stick left|right X Y, center, wait MS, snap PATH, status, quit; ';' chains)
notes: Talks to tmp/ps5-live/ctl.sock (override with PS5_LIVE_DIR). Stick axes: X left -1..right 1, Y up -1..down 1. Exit 1 on an err reply. Use a new filename per snap so the Console does not show a cached image.

name: ps5read
notes: Needs ps5-session running (or --frame). Prints 'y x conf text' in 1280x720 pixels, origin top-left. Uses ocrmac (Apple Vision) from the playstation venv via a sh header, because the harness path has a space and a shebang cannot. About 0.7 s per full frame.

name: rea
command: rea decompile /abs/binary <function> --provider ghidra|hopper --format json   # MCP: mcp__rea__* (170 tools); rea --help for all commands
notes: npm global rea-agents (~/.npm-global/bin/rea); source clone at ~/Documents/rea, scratch at ~/Documents/rea-work. Providers: brew ghidra 12.1.4 + openjdk@21 (REA accepts 12.1.x only), and Hopper demo in ~/Applications. Hopper needs Spotlight indexing ON (its launcher finds the app by mdfind) and Automation permission for the calling app to control Hopper. IDA Free 9.3 + loopback-patched ida-free-mcp plugin installed, waiting for an npm release with the native IDA profile. Provider env is in ~/.zshenv and in the MCP env. MCP is user-scope behind mcp-lazy (idle 0). First Ghidra query takes ~40 s on a tiny binary. Output is swallowed inside mist-progress run, so redirect to a file. Update with bin/rea-update (the skill runs it first); never bare rea setup.

name: render_dice.py
notes: Cycles on Metal, about 6 s per render on the Air. Writes d6-<face>-<turn>.png with a shadow-catcher shadow on alpha; fade the broad shadow radially before cropping or a dark box shows on dark backgrounds.

name: Rental Harmony
notes: AppleScript applet bundle, so there is no shell launcher for scan_apps() to parse.

name: repo-offload
notes: Refuses a repo with unpushed commits or a dirty worktree. Local-only branches and stashes go to ~/Documents/repo-bundles/<name>.bundle (BUNDLE_DIR). Ledger at ~/Exobrain/Projects/Offloaded repos.md (LEDGER). Restore: gh repo clone, then git fetch <bundle> 'refs/*:refs/*'.

name: resume-factcheck
notes: build.py runs it first (--jd, --role, --no-factcheck). True facts not on every resume go in gitignored data/facts.md.

name: ringer_board
notes: Extracts The Ringer's preseason fantasy football rankings (full-PPR/half/superflex/dynasty) from the page's embedded Next.js payload: rank, positional rank, auction value, bye, per-expert ranks + spread, analyst blurb. Their published Google Sheet is half-PPR and stale; this pulls the live board. Re-run before draft day.

name: sab-build-modules
notes: Lives on the android branch of bible-study (an AndBible fork). Turns the scraped Skeptic's Annotated Bible JSON into three SWORD modules (SABKJV Bible, SAB commentary, SABBoM general book) via osis2mod/xml2gbs and writes the bundle the fork installs on first launch. Needs brew install sword. --books gen,1ne for a quick run, --osis-only to skip the tools. main is the iOS app; the modules have no iPhone reader (PocketSword is gone from the App Store).

name: salon-ramon
notes: Books haircuts at Salon Ramon over Rosy Salon Software: ramon slots/book/appointments/cancel, dry-run unless --confirm and verified against a server read. Auth lifts the Google-signed-in JSESSIONID out of Chrome (ramon login) and re-scrapes the 30-minute JWT each run. schedule.py owns the 6-week cadence; launchd com.exobrain.haircut-check runs daily at 10:00. Replaced the Booksy/Rich Forever tool on 2026-09-10.

name: scorebug
command: python3 fantasy/scorebug/deploy [--print] · python3 fantasy/scorebug/snapshot.py [--post] · python3 fantasy/scorebug/test_model.py
notes: View key and ingest token in gitignored scorebug.json. KV free tier: 1000 writes/day (history every 2 min in games). test_model.py must PASS after editing model.js or espncli.value. Cloud publisher = scorebug.yml in BaesTheorem/fantasy-cloud.

name: sdfmesh
command: import sdfmesh  (3dprint/lib, on the path inside cad build model scripts)
notes: Fields are negative inside. mesh_from_field(field(j0,j1), xs, ys, zs) meshes in y slabs that share a row, so the result is closed. lattice() puts z = 0 between samples for clean mid-plane cuts. Always finish with ensure_closed after any transform: tidy() welds vertices within 2 um and snaps to a 0.1 um grid so an STL round trip keeps the topology. decimate() needs fast-simplification; local_thickness() costs about 2 s on a 1M-pixel map.

name: session-memory recall
notes: --deep loads nomic in The Priory venv (about 10 s). Logs each query to ~/Library/Logs/exobrain/zettel-retrievals.jsonl.

name: stalled-repos
notes: Needs gh login. GraphQL secondary rate limit gives 403 waits with 4 shards; retries handle it. Judgment pass uses RUBRIC.md with agents; security repos in the games lane trip the safety classifier, so tell agents to give them a generic skip line. Data in stalled-repos/data (gitignored).

name: standings-history
notes: Read-only via ff raw (mMatchup,mTeam,mSettings). --check compares the last week to ff standings. Idle-week score is not counted in PF. Render the HTML with Playwright (JS-driven).

name: standings_history.py
notes: Read-only (ff raw). A week counts only when every game has a winner. --check exits 1 if the last week disagrees with ff standings.

name: subtile-ocr
notes: Installed with cargo install subtile-ocr. Input is VobSub .idx/.sub: copy the dvd_subtitle stream from the VOBs into an MKV with ffmpeg, then mkvextract tracks. -t and -d had no effect on DVD subs here. Small images (one-word lines) come back blank; dump raw images with --dump-raw, upscale 4x, negate, pad white, and run tesseract --psm 8. Some disc cues carry broken end times; clamp them.

name: supernote-parser.py
notes: Extract PNG pages from a Supernote .note file for vision OCR. A firmware signature bump raises UnsupportedFileFormat -- upgrade supernotelib.

name: switchboard-kc-smoke
notes: Needs web/.env with ADMIN_TOKEN and URL. Read-only: it never files a report. Uses the device id from ../ios/Config/civic-config.json when present.

name: talify.py
notes: Missouri Talify (missouri.talify.com, the jobs.mo.gov front-end) discovery lane. /jobs.json Ransack API; two passes: remote at standard floor (expected-dry, board held 1 remote job at build), KC-local at onsite floor via reduced server pre-filter + client-side band rule from detail pages. compensation_max_gteq is silently ignored by the server; only min_gteq works.

name: tools-registry-scan.py
notes: Rebuilds this whole registry (Tools, Dependencies, Project Dependencies). Runs daily at 07:15 via com.exobrain.tools-registry.

name: Turn To book pipeline
command: tools/recover_headings.py, parse_sections.py, merge_parses.py, page_geometry.py, page_images.py, annotate_rules.py, build_book.py (see README)
notes: Order and flags are in the turn-to README. Book data (scans, OCR, book.json, page images) lives in books/ and is gitignored. corrections.json, overrides.json and plates.json in each book folder hold the hand fixes.

name: tv
notes: Local WSS control CLI for the living-room Samsung TV.

name: vendor-sync.sh
notes: Refresh the vendored UI libraries (Beer CSS, mdui, material-color-utilities, Material Symbols) pinned in vendor.json.

name: verify-quotes
notes: Reads every "> [!quote]" callout in a note. Match ignores case, punctuation and typography; "..." splits a quote into fragments that must occur in order in one file. FUZZY (ratio >= 0.85) means OCR or transcript noise: open the file and copy the real words. Prints up to 3 files per hit with context so you can confirm the speaker. Exit 1 if any quote is missing. Run a positive and a negative control on each new corpus.

name: wait-for-network.sh
notes: Gate any launchd job that hits the network. Jobs that fire on wake before DNS is up fail with ENOTFOUND without it.

name: workday.py
notes: Workday-direct job discovery lane. Polls each tenant CXS API, diffs vs snapshot, gates all 4 gates mechanically (comp parsed from JD, canApply verified). --add pins a filtered board URL. Sibling of ats-watchlist.py (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby).

name: yt-transcript
notes: YouTube captions as clean text via yt-dlp. Prefers human subtitles, falls back to auto-captions. The cleanup is the point: raw auto-captions carry inline karaoke tags (<00:00:01.500><c>word</c>) and a rolling 2-line window that repeats every line verbatim, so a bare yt-dlp dump is ~2x the tokens and reads like a stutter. Verified 4000 raw VTT lines -> 295 clean. Exit 2 = no captions in that language, 3 = fetch blocked. If YouTube throws a bot check, yt-dlp wants a JS runtime: brew install deno.

name: zettel_maintain.py
notes: Waits for running session writers. --dry-run still calls the model. One _maintain note per run lists all changes.
